name: Views Accordion Foundation
description: A Views display plugin rendering results as ZURB Foundation accordions or tabs.
project_description:
Provides a views style plugin to render views content as ZURB Foundation Accordion ( https://foundation.zurb.com/sites/docs/accordion.html )

 + Responsive Accordion Tabs https://foundation.zurb.com/sites/docs/responsive-accordion-tabs.html 

 This module was largely inspired and based on the wonderful Views Accordion module by Manuel Garcia . Thank you so much, Manuel! 

 Back to top 

 How to use: 
 The first views field in the views row is used as the accordion-title, the other fields are going into accordion-content. If you need to use rendered entities, simply use the provided field "Content: Rendered Entity" (as second field!).

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Views (Drupal Core) 
 Foundation Sites (library) - with "complete" (or at least accordion plugin) 
 
 Views Accordion is NOT a dependency because it was too different to be extended.
